notes:
Version 0.3.1.2

Stories
- PDFs from Google Docs now keep their paragraphs. Before, each line of the PDF became its own paragraph.
- PDFs with 1.5 or double line spacing keep their paragraphs too.

Version 0.3.1.1

Credit
- Credit has to be a name from your unit's DVIDS list, or -- Courtesy Asset --. Anything else stops the upload before anything is created, in Submit and on each photo or video.
- Typing still searches the list. Type courtesy to find -- Courtesy Asset --.
- Credit is required unless every photo and video has its own and there's no story. Caption writer no longer fills in for it.
- A courtesy asset goes to DVIDS with no author, and its file name has to include its VIRIN.

Version 0.3.1.0

VIRINs
- The Photographer ID is gone from the main window and Setup.
- At upload, DVIDS issues each VIRIN for the person credited, with their ID and the branch letter DVIDS assigns.
- A file already named with a VIRIN keeps it. Any other file is renamed to its new VIRIN in its folder, and a retry reuses it.
- A file without a VIRIN needs a Credit. A Credit DVIDS can't match to one person stops the upload before anything is created.

Version 0.3.0.1

- Switching between the Media and Submit tabs is cleaner. Hovering brightens the label, and the box slides faster with no bounce.
- Update notes like these now get their own scrolling box in the ? menu.

Version 0.3.0

Uploads
- Long uploads keep going through connection drops of up to about 10 minutes.
- Your Mac stays awake until an upload finishes. Keep a laptop's lid open.
- A network problem no longer sends you back to sign in to DVIDS.
- Updates wait until an upload is finished.

App password
- The app password now encrypts your saved DVIDS sign-in and Secret API key. Older versions of the app can't open them after that.

Show optional fields
- In Media, this gives a photo or video its own Headline, Credit, City, State or province, and Country. A photo can also have its own Caption writer.
- Blank fields use Submit. Unchecking the box stops the typed values from being used.
- A photo or video with its own Credit goes to DVIDS under that author, with a VIRIN from DVIDS for that person unless the file name already has one.
- A Credit or Country that DVIDS can't match stops the upload before anything is created.

Details saved in photos
- Caption writer now also fills Creator and Credit Line in the photo.
- When added photos hold details that differ from Submit, the app asks once whether to Keep saved details or Use Submit, and lists the photos.
- Submit no longer fills itself from a photo. Each photo's own caption still loads.
- Photo dates use the time zone the camera recorded.

Speed
- Adding photos and opening a draft no longer freeze the window.

Design
- The Date calendar is new, with month and year lists, Today and Yesterday, and typing.
- Suggestion lists are redesigned, and the step numbers are gone from the toolbar and tabs.
- A dot on ? shows when an update is ready.

Requirements
- macOS 12 or newer.
